about: Item kinds. category is weapon, armor, tool, gear, consumable, equipment or treasure. use is the effect of using one up; grants are abilities or skills available while it is equipped; modifiers apply while equipped; damage and rider describe a weapon's strike (the granted ability executes it).

rope.name: Coil of rope
rope.description: A length of sturdy rope for climbing, tying, or securing items.

source.notes: Orsino gives a description and price; Kyr gives the tool meaning through world rules.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.description: A sturdy crowbar for prying open doors or crates.

source.notes: Orsino gives a description and price; Kyr gives the tool meaning through world rules.

thieves_tools.name: Thieves' tools
thieves_tools.description: A set of tools for picking locks and disarming traps.

source.notes: Orsino gives a description and price; Kyr gives the tool meaning through world rules.

shovel.name: Shovel
shovel.description: A sturdy shovel for digging or moving earth.

source.notes: Orsino gives a description and price; Kyr gives the tool meaning through world rules.

bell.name: Bell
bell.description: A small bell that can be used to signal others or scare off wildlife.

source.notes: Orsino gives a description and price; Kyr gives the tool meaning through world rules.

map.name: Map of the district
map.description: A hand-drawn map of the local roads and landmarks.

source.notes: Starting gear of the explorer; absent from Orsino's gear catalog.

bandages.name: Bandages
bandages.description: Clean linen for binding wounds. One use.

source.notes: Starting gear of the medic; absent from Orsino's gear catalog.

herbs.name: Healing herbs
herbs.description: A twist of dried herbs for a poultice. One use.

source.notes: Starting gear of the medic; absent from Orsino's gear catalog.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: A single dose removes the poisoned condition from a living companion.

source.notes: Orsino removes the status named Poison; Kyr removes poisoned.

healingdraught.name: Minor healing potion
healingdraught.description: A single dose restores 2d4 + 2 health to a living companion.

fireproof_salve.name: Fireproof salve
fireproof_salve.description: A clay pot of ash-and-lanolin salve. Smeared on skin and clothing, it makes fire do half its harm for a while.
fireproof_salve.use: Apply fireproof to ally for 10 turns.

source.notes: A Kyr preparation of Orsino's fireproof; lasts ten of the wearer's combat turns.

yarrow_poultice.name: Prepared yarrow poultice
yarrow_poultice.description: Crushed yarrow bound in a cloth. It stops bleeding and eases a small wound.
yarrow_poultice.use: Remove bleeding from ally. Heal (1d3) health to ally.

longsword_of_flames.name: Longsword of Flames
longsword_of_flames.description: A steel blade bearing an old foundry ward. Fire runs along it when it strikes.

source.notes: Exact dice and types; the strike is a Kyr attack roll against 10.

warding_focus.name: Foundry ward focus
warding_focus.description: A copper warding focus. A companion who knows how can raise a ward against fire with it.

source.notes: Kyr implement that grants the fire ward technique.
